title: Exploring the prognostic role of senescence-related genes in gastric cancer through multi-omics integration and machine learning.
authors: Cao, Yangkun; Li, Dongjie; Bao, Li; Ding, Xiaoling; Guo, Yongzhen; Ni, Xiaobo; Liu, Yang
one_liner_zh: 该文通过多组学整合与机器学习构建胃癌衰老相关基因预后模型，虽涉及上游转录因子调控网络分析，但核心是临床预后与肿瘤分型，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合机制研究，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Cellular senescence plays a context-dependent role in gastric cancer (GC), functioning both through tumor-suppressive arrest and the tumor-promoting senescence-associated secretory phenotype. However, its systematic integration into prognostic models remains limited. Here, we develop a novel interpretable framework to identify and validate a robust senescence-related gene signature for GC prognosis. We first introduce a dual-model interpretable feature selection strategy that integrates a biologically informed Kolmogorov-Arnold Network with a tabular foundation model to identify cancer-associated senescence genes. From the initial candidates, an ensemble of ten machine learning algorithms distills a core 4-gene signature to construct a Senescence Risk Score (SRS). The SRS proves to be a powerful and independent prognostic indicator, effectively stratifies patients into high- and low-risk groups with distinct overall survival across multiple cohorts. High-risk patients exhibit an "immune-hot" but potentially dysfunctional tumor microenvironment, characterized by enriched immune cell infiltration, elevated checkpoint expression, and distinct metabolic reprogramming favoring pathways such as angiogenesis and epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT). Furthermore, the SRS correlates with differential somatic mutation profiles and suggests potential sensitivity to specific chemotherapeutic agents. In vitro functional assays confirmed the oncogenic role of SERPINE1, a top-ranked core gene, in promoting GC cell proliferation. Regulatory network analysis revealed potential upstream transcription factors and miRNAs governing the signature. Collectively, we present a validated senescence-related prognostic signature that enables effective risk stratification of patients with gastric cancer.
abstract_zh: 细胞衰老在胃癌（GC）中发挥情境依赖性作用，既通过肿瘤抑制性停滞发挥作用，也通过促肿瘤的衰老相关分泌表型发挥作用。然而，其在预后模型中的系统性整合仍有限。在此，我们开发了一种新颖的可解释框架，以识别并验证用于胃癌预后的稳健衰老相关基因特征。我们首先引入一种双模型可解释特征选择策略，该策略整合了生物学信息化的Kolmogorov-Arnold网络与表格基础模型，以识别癌症相关衰老基因。从初始候选基因中，十种机器学习算法的集成提炼出一个核心4基因特征，以构建衰老风险评分（SRS）。SRS被证明是一个强大且独立的预后指标，能有效将患者分层为具有不同总生存期的高风险组和低风险组，且该结果在多个队列中一致。高风险患者表现出“免疫热”但可能功能失调的肿瘤微环境，其特征为免疫细胞浸润丰富、检查点表达升高，以及有利于血管生成和上皮-间质转化（EMT）等通路的独特代谢重编程。此外，SRS与差异体细胞突变谱相关，并提示对特定化疗药物的潜在敏感性。体外功能实验证实了核心基因中排名靠前的SERPINE1在促进胃癌细胞增殖中的致癌作用。调控网络分析揭示了调控该特征的潜在上游转录因子和miRNA。总体而言，我们提出了一种经过验证的衰老相关预后特征，能够实现对胃癌患者的有效风险分层。
